assertions.subject: thrombotic microangiopathic conditions
assertions.quote: Schistocytes, or fragmented RBCs, are characteristic of thrombotic microangiopathic conditions

assertions.subject: bone marrow infiltration
assertions.quote: Teardrop cells, nucleated RBCs, and leukoerythroblastic features suggest bone marrow infiltration

assertions.subject: megaloblastic anemia
assertions.quote: Nutritional deficiencies causing megaloblastic anemia manifest as hypersegmented neutrophils and macro-ovalocytes

assertions.subject: thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: those with platelet counts below 20,000/µL often present with spontaneous bleeding

assertions.subject: ITP
assertions.quote: Oral purpura and gross hematuria warrant special attention, as they may precede severe hemorrhage associated with ITP

assertions.subject: Bleeding disorder
assertions.quote: A detailed bleeding history should include petechiae, hemorrhagic events, gingival bleeding, and epistaxis
